name: Document retention or restricted movement reported
description: Audit or customer information indicates passports withheld, workers housed on site or unable to leave.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: ILO, Profits and Poverty: The Economics of Forced Labour (2014)
OECD, Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Business Conduct (2018)
FATF and APG, Financial Flows from Human Trafficking (2018)
